purpose: Installer warning candidates, not a blocklist, anti-cheat bypass, ban predictor, or compatibility whitelist.

policy.name_matching: Exact Windows ordinal case-insensitive basename comparison; never substring, wildcard, regex, or loose suffix match.
policy.name_only_claim: Candidate game association, not identity or runtime anti-cheat proof.
policy.context_required_names: Not eligible for flat basename matching. Require independently established selected-game identity.
policy.app_identity: A matching platform app ID must own the resolved installation root containing the selected target. Identity alone may trigger warning even when the EXE is renamed.
policy.folder_scan: Bounded, read-only enumeration within the trusted selected game root. Do not traverse reparse points, parent library/drive roots, or sibling game folders. Unknown root: name check only, plus clearly incomplete local scan.
policy.source_paths: Observed source-relative paths are provenance/context hints, not mandatory fixed paths. They must not be used to rewrite injection routing.
policy.timing: Evaluate and ask before any install/update/repair mutation, backup, file copy, proxy replacement, or settings write.
policy.permissions: No anti-cheat bypass, service modification, provider execution, file deletion, launch-flag changes, or alternate-loader safety claims.
policy.uninstall: Do not obstruct removal. Existing restoration ownership/manifest rules remain authoritative.
policy.failure_policy: A missing/invalid dataset or incomplete scan is unknown; preserve usable Back and explicit Proceed. Never display Safe or No anti-cheat.
policy.consent_scope: One resolved target and current install/update/repair operation. No global never-warn preference by default. Target change invalidates confirmation.
policy.provider_names: Display only as reported metadata. Neither multiple providers nor local marker presence establishes concurrent live protection.
policy.offline: Do not globally suppress warnings for offline, private, solo, co-op, training, or single-player selections. Supported mod modes are game-specific and not evaluated here.

warning_text.title: Warning: anti-cheat risk
warning_text.identified_game: {game_title} is known or reported to use anti-cheat. Installing or running NeuRotic with this game may cause launch failures, removal from online sessions, or an account ban. NeuRotic is not confirmed compatible with this game's anti-cheat. Do not use it in anti-cheat-protected multiplayer.
warning_text.publisher_confirmed_game: {game_title} is known to use anti-cheat. Installing or running NeuRotic with this game may cause launch failures, removal from online sessions, or an account ban. NeuRotic is not confirmed compatible with this game's anti-cheat. Do not use it in anti-cheat-protected multiplayer.
warning_text.basename_match: This executable name matches {game_title}, a game known or reported to use anti-cheat. This is a name match, not confirmation of the game or active protection. Installing or running NeuRotic could cause launch failures, removal from online sessions, or an account ban. Do not use it in anti-cheat-protected multiplayer.
warning_text.local_marker: Anti-cheat-related files were found in the selected game installation. This does not prove that anti-cheat is currently active. Installing or running NeuRotic could cause launch failures, removal from online sessions, or an account ban. Do not use it in anti-cheat-protected multiplayer.
warning_text.incomplete_scan: Anti-cheat compatibility could not be checked completely. No compatibility assurance is available. Do not use NeuRotic in anti-cheat-protected multiplayer.
warning_text.option_1: Proceed anyway - I understand the risk
warning_text.unattended_policy: Require an explicit per-invocation anti-cheat-risk acknowledgement or return a needs-confirmation result; never convert missing input into consent.
